title: Talking about a new job
instructions: İki arkadaş birinin yeni işini konuşuyor. Eski ve yeni işi karşılaştır.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Can! I heard you have a new job.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, I started last Monday. I'm working for a travel company now.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Do you like it more than the bank?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Much more. The work is more interesting, and my colleagues are really friendly.

script.speaker: b
script.text: It's a little less, but I don't have to work on Saturdays any more.

script.speaker: a
script.text: That's great. And it's closer to your home, isn't it?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, I can walk there in ten minutes.

questions.prompt: When did Can start his new job?

questions.evidence: Do you like it more than the bank?
